name: squat
phone: On the floor or a low stand, 2 to 3 metres away, the whole body in the picture: side-on, from the front, or in between.

ready.from: Standing tall: the knees within 20 degrees of straight (the usual definition; not fitted).
Standing tall: the trunk within 20 degrees of upright (the usual definition; not fitted).

rules.name: depth
rules.from: Set by movement-check from 9 people's videos (scripts/movementVideos.ts), as filmed and as each replay that sets numbers (scripts/replays.ts), 354 reps: a quarter of the way back towards standing from the shallowest rep (0.22; standing 0).

rules.name: knees bent
rules.from: Set by movement-check from 9 people's videos (scripts/movementVideos.ts), as filmed and as each replay that sets numbers (scripts/replays.ts), 354 reps: a quarter of the way back towards standing from the shallowest rep (107.36; standing 174.67).

rules.name: hips and knees together
rules.from: Set by movement-check from 9 people's videos (scripts/movementVideos.ts), as filmed and as each replay that sets numbers (scripts/replays.ts), 354 reps: beyond the furthest rep by half its distance from the middle rep (24.45; standing 4.21).
